# Schedule 13D/G official-source fixtures

Fetched from SEC EDGAR on 2026-09-23. Fixtures contain original decoded UTF-8 source text with LF line endings; hashes cover that text. Tests never require live SEC access. XML issuer identity must match the subject company; the four excluded NVDA-index documents prove that a company submissions index also contains its reports about other issuers. No ownership observations are published for those other issuers.

Selection: reviewed structured 13G filings found in the recent index from 2025-01-01; three older SOFI 13D amendments (4?6) illustrate factual purpose, joint reporting and scope changes. Trimmed submissions fixtures keep selected entries plus an older guard entry. This is not a complete historical ownership register.

XML cover-page numbers, powers, dates and names are parsed. Legacy 13D cover-page values are explicitly reviewed with exact supporting passages and full-source hashes; no generic HTML guessing. Legal reporting relationships, identity links and comparability decisions live in `scripts/source_reviews/company_ownership.json`. In-memory modifications in tests are synthetic and do not replace these sources.
